scope: Curve25519-family miniatures k = 20, 24, 28, 32, five dev curves (screen) and five fresh sibling curves (confirmation) per size, one-seed wwalk (g=1, grow=1, seed=run) on a size=1 base, ecbench counted GAE at w = 0, local route L1; no signed replay or recompute; boundary result outside the main ratchet
statement: C = 1 boundary study (research/curve25519_autolab_20261104/c1): a one-seed wwalk screen of 20 arms on five dev curves per size (3600 records per size, audit 3600/3600 and 8 replays reproduced at each size) gave one pre-registered arm per size. On five fresh curves per size (540 records per size, audit 540/540, 8 replays reproduced) the pre-registered arm has mean per-curve S / rho-neg of 1.40 (k = 20, range 1.24 to 1.51), 1.60 (k = 24, 1.37 to 1.74), 1.74 (k = 28, 1.50 to 1.95) and 1.69 (k = 32, 1.42 to 2.01), against 1.79, 1.88, 1.86 and 2.04 for the C = 2 baseline arm run in the same sessions. Mean S of the C = 1 arm is 2.227, 1.814, 1.711 and 1.545, none below the C = 1 collision floor of 1.329. The 1.3x target is not met at k = 20 or k = 24; the screen's 1.26x at k = 20 was selection on the dev curves. Provenance: the C = 1 oracle mode comes from another session's work-in-progress commit.
